resources.string: Interactive App Tour
Follow the highlights to discover your library, reading tools, study notes, and settings.
What should we call you?
Please enter your name so we can personalize your dashboard and messages.
Quest 1: Add a Document
This is the Add button. Tap it to import PDFs, EPUBs, Word files, text files, images, or web links.
Your Quest Checklist
This floating checklist shows your active missions. Complete all quests to master the app!
Classic Books Catalog
Browse timeless books by genre, swipe through each shelf, and add a favourite to My Library. Your reading and listening stay close at hand.
Reading Insights Dashboard
This menu button opens your personalized dashboard. Tap Next to see your reading analytics.
Your Insights at a Glance
Track daily reading streaks on the heatmap, see how your library splits by source, and watch where your listening time goes each month — all stored privately on your device.
Notes & Voice Memos
Here is your notes studio. Review all your document annotations, standalone notes, bookmarks, and audio recordings in one dedicated hub.
AI Study Hub & Flashcards
Here is your study studio. Generate AI summaries, practice interactive flashcards, and review active recall quizzes across your library.
Settings & Customization
Here is your settings hub. Tune voice engines, playback speeds, themes, cloud sync, backup tools, and pronunciation rules anytime.
Open your Document
Your readings appear here. Tap a card to open it and enter the reader screen.
Layout Mode Switcher
Toggle layouts dynamically: TEXT for clean reading, LISTEN for lyrics/sentence highlights, and ORIGINAL for PDF layouts.
Expandable Playback Studio
Tap or drag this panel up to access speed, pitch, premium voice selections, and sleep timers.
Highlight & Study Actions
Long-press any sentence to bookmark it, add study notes, translate text, or consult the AI Assistant.
Tour Complete!
Awesome! You have completed the guided tour. Now complete the remaining quests on your checklist to unlock the full app!
